ref_affine_on_hf_train.definition: min-norm least-squares affine map condition->field fit on the HF train rows (tools/make_round3_anchors.py::affine_fit, np.linalg.lstsq rcond=None); program.md (round 3) §2 MANDATORY reported arm next to every ifc number — an ifc claim that does not beat it has learned nothing beyond linearity

prereg.cell_role: reproduction control (B2 measured knee cap 5); pre-declared UNRESOLVED at tau_rel_film 0.335905

design_rank.reading: if this saturates far BELOW the knee, the knee is not a condition-space-rank story

nnc_field_oracle.reading: if it never goes usefully below 1.0, the knee is not a coverage-radius story

fold_population_histogram_summary.reason: this cell's HF train split is native N_hf = 5 (one fold); the C(N_train, 5) fold population is a single point, so a 64-draw histogram is degenerate

reproduction_control.note: STATED, NOT ADJUSTED. The dense ladder is the card's own verbatim {5,10,20,40,80,160,320,FULL} and the registered ladder is the card's own mechanical rule applied to c_hat; neither was moved to make a control cap reachable.

prereg.role: PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION. The trained step-max knee K is computed ANALYSIS-SIDE from the five legs of this cell; this family emits no cross-arm quantity and never compares K to c_pred in-process.

knee_prereg.arm_role: matched control arm of the scored contrast

registered_statistic.R: R(c) = (nRMSE(A0_nolf) - nRMSE(arm@c)) / (nRMSE(A0_nolf) - nRMSE(A1_lf_all)) per fold (HF draw x training seed), fold-mean; REFERENCE-FREE
registered_statistic.knee: K = r_{argmax(s)+1} in {r2, r3, FULL} — threshold-free in R by construction; NO absolute R threshold anywhere
registered_statistic.margin: M_R = max(s) - second-max(s); M_film = M_R * E_ds / nrmse_film_mean(ds), E_ds = fold-mean (nRMSE(A0) - nRMSE(A1))
registered_statistic.adjudicability: ADJUDICABLE iff M_film > tau_rel_film(ds) with a CERTIFIED tau_rel AND the per-seed knee is unanimous over seeds {0,1,2}; the 9-fold leave-one-out jackknife modal knee is reported, not gating
registered_statistic.primary_claim: the pre-declared c_pred equals the trained step-max knee K on each predictive cell; chance match 1/3 per cell
registered_statistic.note: ALL of it is ANALYSIS-SIDE. This family computes no cross-arm quantity and never compares K with c_pred in-process.

knee_prereg.budget_equality: EVERY arm of this card is step-matched at N_hf = 5: identical optimizer steps and identical HF-row exposure; the LF arms' extra rung forward IS the treatment. No budget-varied arm exists here (B2's A5 is not run).
knee_prereg.seed_semantics: R3S3B3_SPLIT_SEED is an HF-SUBSET DRAW, not a training seed. The training seed is --seed, and this card runs seeds {0,1,2} as three SLURM jobs. Draws must never be bootstrapped as a seed CI.

hf_draw_nesting.reason: this leg's HF rows are the native full train split

split.note: the N_hf rows are SELECTED from the existing train split; no HF sample is added and no file is regenerated (program.md §5.11)

lf_selector.membership: exact condition-row match, key = tuple(np.round(row, 12)) (tools/affine_ladder_voi.py A7 convention)
lf_selector.cap_rule: per rung, np.sort(default_rng([split_seed, fid]).permutation(n_candidates)[:cap]) — see coverage.cap_draw for the TBD this resolves and why the draw is per rung

scalers.definition: max|y| over ALL rows of the rung in the stripped TRAIN view (HF rung: all HF train rows, NOT the N_hf draw)
scalers.cross_leg_verification: s_rung / s_hf / s_rung_over_s_hf are recorded on every leg; equality across the whole grid is verified analysis-side from those records

lf_row_manifest.axis_note: the causal axis of the ladder is n_distinct_conditions (union over rungs of the kept condition keys), NOT n_rows; card recipe.env._cap_semantics
lf_row_manifest.definition: condition key = tuple(np.round(row, 12)), the round's registered convention (tools/affine_ladder_voi.py A7)

cond_standardization.source: the N_hf HF train rows (identical in every arm at a given dataset/split_seed/N_hf)

ckpt_data_binding.computed_once_per_leg: the block is a pure function of (dataset_dir, dataset_name, roles_read); recomputing it at each save would re-hash the whole dataset ~20x per leg
ckpt_data_binding.test_lf_note: test_lf is read by NEITHER arm (stripped test view, program.md §5 immutable #9): it carries the copy-LF denominator only, which is why a test_lf change is REREFERENCE and never RETRAIN

design_coverage.design: [Z_hf, 1] (per-dim standardized by the N_hf HF train rows)

raw_design.note: [X_hf, 1] in RAW condition units — the coordinate system of tools/affine_ladder_voi.py

anchor_affine_seam_check.anchor_definition: min-norm least-squares affine map condition->field, fit on the HF train rows; mandatory reported arm for ifc claims (program.md section 2), NOT in best_floor
anchor_affine_seam_check.note: program.md (round 3) §2 affine-floor rule: an ifc claim that does not beat this fitted floor has learned nothing beyond linearity

hf_rung.definition: statistics of tools/target_scale_spread_audit.py applied to THIS family's actual normalised target y / max|y| (per rung), not to a residual target — this family has none; reported, never a switch

response_decomposition.reason: R3S3B3_ALIGNMENT_REPORT=0 — card recipe.base_family: 'the B2 D-D mediator clause is NOT re-run (B2 part 7 item 4)'

forward_sensitive_stratification.terminology: FORWARD-SENSITIVE subpopulation: condition-space-indistinguishable (max per-dim standardised gap 0.4476 sigma, nearest-train-neighbour ratio 1.0176) but field-distant (nearest-train-field rel-L2 ratio 3.29). Measured by r3s1_factorised-B1 turn 3 (T3c) on the 27 seed-invariant hard rows of sharp__cahn_hilliard's 100-row test split.

split_identity.convention: sha256 of np.round(cond_test, 12).tobytes(), C-order float64 — the round's registered condition-key rounding

forward_sensitive_stratification.scored_metric: per-row rel-L2 of the SCORED test split, the round's one nRMSE definition (round2/eval/nrmse.py), taken from splits.test_hf.rel_l2_per_sample

rederived_model_free.definition: top 27.00% (35 of 128) test rows by min_j ||y_te_i - y_train_j|| / ||y_te_i|| over the FULL HF train split; model-free, dataset-general

forward_sensitive_stratification.comparability_note: MODEL-FREE and identical in every arm, cap, draw and seed of this card's grid, because it is a function of the dataset alone. B2 published a SECOND, MODEL-DEPENDENT ch mask (imported from r3s1_factorised-B1's per-row rel-L2 bimodality) and measured overlap 19/27, jaccard 0.543 against this same re-derivation; this card imports nothing, so the comparison is made analysis-side from B2's published row indices and this leg's `split_identity` digest.

film_units.denominator_role: DENOMINATOR ONLY — never an arm of this card

g5_nn_condition_fitset_band.direction: the matched-fit-set correction always makes the reference arm WORSE, so a model margin priced against it WIDENS
g5_nn_condition_fitset_band.rule: any claim priced against an nn_condition best floor carries this band beside tau_rel (operator adoption, 2026-08-10)
g5_nn_condition_fitset_band.source: experiment_cards/r3s4_audit/batch_2/B2.json :: orchestrator_adjudication_g5_2026_08_10 (operator adoption, Eloise, 2026-08-10); underlying artifact reanalysis_turn_2_repricing.json

mean_removed.definition: mean_i ||(p_i - <p_i>) - (y_i - <y_i>)||_2 / ||y_i - <y_i>||_2, <.> = the sample's spatial mean (benchmark_42 dataset-card convention) composed with round2/eval/nrmse.py
mean_removed.carded_scope: the card names sharp__fisher_kpp_2d and ifc_heat explicitly (level-domination); it is computed on every cell because reporting more costs nothing and reporting less would break the requirement

floor_tolerances.affine_arm_declaration: affine_on_hf_train is NOT YET ADJUDICABLE under the installed per-dataset table: its own per-arm band exceeds the recommended tolerance on 8 of 10 datasets. Any card asserting an affine reproduction must adjudicate against the pinned per-arm band below (tools/floor_arm_precision_band.py estimators, D2 config seed 1 B=64), not the dataset-level table. This closes 6 of B2's 7 @full misses as metrology; the surviving genuinely unexplained miss is sharp__allen_cahn_2d:train_mean 5.454e-11 (7.3x OUTSIDE its arm band 7.493e-12, inside the dataset-level 1e-9).
floor_tolerances.rule: F1-class floor reproductions adjudicate against dataset_tolerance for nn_condition / train_mean / zero, and against affine_arm_pinned_band for affine_on_hf_train (install note: the affine arm is NOT adjudicable under the dataset-level table)

r3_certified.definition: tau_rel (same-reference comparisons). Use tau_abs against an absolute bar or across eras.
r3_certified.source: r3s4_audit-B1 condition->HF 3-seed spread (family r3s4_cert_min, smoke tier 200 epochs, seeds 0,1,2) fused with a paired test-row bootstrap of the scored cell

min_claimable_effect.note: round-3 CERTIFIED noise floor only; no round-2 file is consulted under this mode (card r3s3_lf_value-B2 recipe.env has no R3S3B3_NOISE_FLOOR_R2_JSON key)

reporting_discipline.reference_free_source: FROZEN constant — the card's recipe.env has no R3S3B3_REFERENCE_FREE_DATASETS key; the value is the card's own _reporting_discipline sentence
reporting_discipline.primary_units: FILM (ADR r3-0006, batch-3 scope rule 1): skill_film = nRMSE / nrmse_film_mean(ds). Copy-LF is NOT a target on this card and is kept only as the identity check skill_film = skill_copylf * c_ds.
reporting_discipline.rule: reference-bearing: skill against the eval layer's copy-LF / paper-bar denominator is quotable for this dataset, but the card's registered unit is still film
reporting_discipline.ifc_affine_floor_rule: program.md (round 3) §2: every ifc number is reported next to the fitted affine_on_hf_train floor WITH its leave-one-out fold range (ifc_heat single-fit 0.070918 = skill 0.9584, LOO mean 1.8469, fold sd ~10.9 tau_rel) and the paper bar 0.074 — see splits.ref_affine_on_hf_train and gate_report.floor_tolerances
reporting_discipline.datasets_of_this_card: sharp__cahn_hilliard,sharp__allen_cahn_2d,sharp__fisher_kpp_2d,sharp__phase_field_crystal_2d,ifc_heat (explicit list from R3S3B3_CELLS; --datasets panel is NEVER used — it resolves the ROUND-2 panel)

dropped.ifc_poisson: REPORT-ONLY under ADR r3-0007 option C (ratified 2026-08-10): its condition->HF map is exactly affine (oracle residual 5.4e-16). This card runs no ifc_poisson leg and its predictive-cell clause is deleted per the card's _ifc_clause_status.
